lines.text: Can I take a rain check? I have homework.

data.define: A polite way to say no now and yes later.

example.text: Can I take a rain check? I have homework.

misuse.text: Don't ask for a 'rain check' after canceling thrice.
misuse.why: It sounds like an empty excuse.

publish.title: What does "rain check" mean?
publish.value: Rain check = Maybe another time, please. Example: "Can I take a rain check? I have homework." (casual English, US).
